definitions.reconciled: stitched instance that replaced / was compared to a matched instance of another tile (IoU >= match_iou) or won / lost contested voxels to another tile's instance
definitions.pred_crosses_core: prediction extends beyond the core of the tile that owns it (carried by the halo)
definitions.gt_crosses_core: GT bbox spans >= 2 tile cores (seam GT); interior = inside one core
definitions.group_f1: TP / FN over the GT group, FP = unmatched evaluated predictions of the matching pred group
